name: Cyber HQ Radar
description: All-in-one cyberpunk fleet command dashboard for Orca: live Bots, multi-host workers, real-time CPU/RAM/Disk/GPU gauges, engine mix icons, fullscreen wallboard, and 1080p video export.

cover.alt: Cyber HQ Radar dashboard showing live Orca Bots, 5 AI engine icons, animated mesh conduits, and host CPU/RAM/Disk/GPU gauges

screenshots.alt: All-in-one 3-layer live fleet topology with Bot brains, Engine Mix chart, and real-time host gauges
screenshots.caption: All-in-One Fleet Command Wall: Bot Brains -> Mesh Radar -> Compute Machines & Hosted Workers

screenshots.alt: Interactive spotlight mode pinning a GPU node to isolate its dispatching Bots and active worker conduits
screenshots.caption: Interactive Spotlight Mode: pin any machine to trace its exact Bot-to-Worker dispatch conduits

statusBarItems.tooltip: Cyber HQ Radar — Live Bots & Multi-Host Workers

settings.title: Bot Control Environment
settings.description: Paired Orca environment that hosts your Bot control plane (leave blank for auto-detection: uses local Orca when Bots exist locally, otherwise auto-selects a paired environment with Bots).

settings.title: Remote SSH Targets
settings.description: Optional comma-separated envName=user@host map for remote CPU/RAM/Disk/GPU telemetry (e.g. mac-mini=user@100.x.y.z,gpu-box=user@100.x.y.w). Defaults to each paired environment's endpoint host or SSH config alias.

settings.title: Hub Relay URLs (Optional Override)
settings.description: Optional comma-separated envName=http://host:port#token overrides. On Tailscale, paired hubs running scripts/hub-relay.mjs on port 19768 are discovered automatically with zero config via Tailscale WhoIs.

settings.title: Show Local Machine Card
settings.description: Display this computer in the compute host column. Turn off on a dedicated monitoring laptop when you only want to watch remote paired servers.

settings.title: Refresh Interval (Seconds)
settings.description: How often Cyber HQ Radar sweeps fleet status and hardware telemetry.
